remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502)
add_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x600)

spec2def(objsel.dll objsel.spec)

add_idl_reg_objects(objsel registry objsel_classes.idl)

# objsel.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/objsel-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(objsel_shims OBJECT objsel.c)
target_link_libraries(objsel_shims PRIVATE uuid wine wine_dll_register wine_dll_canunload libole32 libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(objsel_shims)
set(OBJSEL_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/win32/objsel/objsel_classes_r.o)
add_cargo_module(objsel objsel-cargo objsel.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS objsel_shims psdk objsel_r ${OBJSEL_REUSED} uuid_sources)
